inputs.goal: Deploy a public-network Microsoft Foundry hackathon environment with a default project, GPT and embedding model deployments, Azure AI Search, and Blob Storage.
subGoals: Use Microsoft Entra ID and managed identities for all service-to-service access.
Disable local key authentication on Microsoft Foundry, Azure AI Search, and Storage.
Allow public networking while retaining encrypted transport and RBAC authorization.
Keep names, locations, SKUs, model versions, and capacities configurable.

resources.name: Microsoft Foundry account and project
resources.reason: Hosts the hackathon project, models, agents, and project connections.

resources.name: Model deployments
resources.reason: Deploys gpt-5-mini and text-embedding-3-large with configurable versions, SKU, and capacity.

resources.name: Azure AI Search
resources.reason: Supports vector, hybrid, semantic, and Foundry IQ retrieval scenarios.

resources.name: Storage account and project-aurora container
resources.reason: Stores documents that Azure AI Search indexers can read with managed identity.

resources.name: Role assignments
resources.reason: Grants Search access to Blob data and Foundry identities access to Search without keys.

tradeoffs: Public network access is enabled because the user explicitly requested public networking for the hackathon.
Private endpoints and centralized diagnostics are intentionally omitted to keep the workshop deployment small and easy to operate.
Model availability and quota vary by region, so model versions, deployment SKU, capacity, and model location are parameters.
